workflow.description: SO-ARM 101 surgical-scissor pick-and-place, using the upstream rule-based controller.

episodes.description: Requested successful episodes per scenario; unsuccessful attempts remain recorded.

attempts.description: Maximum attempts per requested episode, matching upstream semantics.

episode_steps.description: Null preserves the upstream 600-step scene cap at 60 Hz. An explicit value may only lower it; a time-limited attempt is not task success.

physics.description: Null selects the upstream scene default (PhysX). Scissor scene Newton execution is not supported by this runtime.

cameras.description: Record upstream room and wrist RGB sensors; false explicitly requests trajectories without camera images.
